pre_freeze_correction: Requested longer true correct-choice feedback in BOTH synthetic2+2 variants because the initial10-character string failed the existing12-character minimum. Designer changed only that shared statement and associated hashes before freeze or dispatch. No gold decision changed.
manual_findings: All three sound variants have one supported matching key, meaningfully distinct task-specific alternatives, and sound main/all-choice feedback. All three defective variants require rejection for their labeled defects.

Aune R2 allows however to attach to either independent clause, with a comma separating the attachment and a semicolon separating clauses. The old unqualified item therefore permits at least the two however placements; its broad feedback is false. The repaired explicit second-clause placement makes the intended construction unique. No claim about the semicolon-and alternative is needed to prove rejection.
The2+2 defective item has unique key4 and true feedback, but2 andtwo are the same proposed value. Replacing two with5 removes that equivalence; both wrongness labels alone are irrelevant to meaning.

The value question permits0.5,1/2 and50%, which are equal numerical answers and give three equivalent pairs. The explicit digits/decimal-point/no-slash/no-percent task tests written representation, so those forms are task-distinct and only0.5 qualifies. Both variants have identical feedback, whose notation restrictions are justified only by the repaired stem.
All30 learner prose fields, all six exact key memberships, all36 pair identities, repaired-field scope and captured-source fidelity were checked.
